environment.operation: At each admitted environmental opportunity increment epoch once. A physical free-pass token exists per station/port. Verified actual passage consumes an available token and sets rechargeAt=epoch+3; a paid passage while empty does not extend that deadline. Replenish under the fixed epoch law. Control keeps tokens available. No visit list, optimal route, host choice, RAW edit or injected punishment.
environment.cost: Empty token makes selected port cost2 under the existing chosen-port toll contract; available token costs0; paid panel query costs1. Ports remain usable with sufficient actual stock. No intense saturation; no extra adverse pulses.
environment.sensing: Actual gate/panel attributes are the source. Paid local stationSignal 0/1/2 is emitted only after ASK executes near that panel. Both arms retain same local tag. Availability audit is not an extra Native JSON field.
environment.feedback: Existing R07 actual collision/invalidAction/codeRejected bool only. Toll alone is not generic failure in this actor. This protocol does not silently change feedback semantics.
environment.guard: If both local ports empty at a sample, stop before Native: codec lacks both-paid state. Preflight must prove this absent for all graph traces within6; do not collapse it into signal1.
